description:

In this Kata, we talk about belief and why, after 14 years of building companies, I think it matters more than technology, people, or distribution. We look at an essay contrasting Rousseau and Benjamin Franklin, and why you are not how you think, but how you act.

We discuss the difference between ambitious beliefs worth chasing and ones that are just self-destructive, and why optionality, fundraising, and the wrong environment can quietly break your belief in yourself.

We then look at how we think about belief at AEOS. The goal is not to believe blindly, but to hold strong beliefs loosely enough that reality decides whether you were right.
